reponse: The root cause was disks on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 filling up after the retention change in infra PR #221; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled [2][3]. The batch size change in #388 was a red herring: reverting it didn't stop the lag [1][3], and it was re-applied on Friday [5]. Earlier reasoning blamed #388 [1], but later evidence in that same session contradicts it. Duration was 2h47m, events delayed up to 2h47m, none lost [2].
